description: A flickering glitch with RGB offset, ghosting and scanlines that flashes back to the outgoing image. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-drop-zone-flicker", duration }] }).
